method: Local browser GLB SHA/bytes check, direct front and back screenshots, provider preview comparison
observations: The output is a thin relief-like irregular silhouette rather than a complete kneeling human figure.
Dark damage marks and neighboring figure fragments have become prominent surface features.
Both front and back lack readable face, arms and kneeling anatomy.
The source figure has only 62x147 native pixels; enlargement did not recover missing visual information.
decision: Keep the raw single-task result as an independent trial; do not substitute it for the story's walking Zhang Qian.
sourceBoundary: Early Tang mural form; hidden depth and back views are inference, not Han archaeology.
nextPotentialApproach: A separate authorized attempt could use a clearer source or a reviewed simplified character concept; no further paid task was submitted in this trial.
